classification.difficultyReason: Convert the given capacity to cubic centimetres before reversing V=Ah with the supplied base area.

content.prompt:
A container is in the shape of a triangular prism that has a capacity of 12 litres.

The area of the base is $240\text{ cm}^2$. What is the distance, $h$, between the ends of the container?

spec.description: Vertical triangular prism, lower triangular face shaded, lower rear edge dashed, external height arrow, two-line NOT TO SCALE and curved area leader.
spec.mathematics: Congruent triangular ends ABC and DEF with D=A+(0,-3), E=B+(0,-3), F=C+(0,-3) in projection. Faces ABC, DEF, ABED, BCFE and CADF. The viewing direction shows the upper end and the two lateral faces meeting at CF; DE is the hidden rear lower edge. Lower-face shading identifies the given cross-sectional area rather than asserting that the face is externally visible. No true triangular side lengths or angles are supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Given base area and unknown h only.
